title: The Nashville Showstopper - 2 miles to Broadway!
description:
Welcome to the NASHVILLE SHOWSTOPPER!

***NEWLY RENOVATED AS OF JUNE 2025***

Lay-out Summary:
1st Floor: Living/Dining/Kitchen, Full Bathroom, Private Garage
2nd Floor: Bedroom (1King) and Indoor/Outdoor Living Space, Bedroom (1Queen) with Private Balcony, Bedroom (1Queen & 2 Bunks - all luxury mattress XL twins - same length as a King), Hallway Full Bathroom, Laundry Area in Hallway
3rd Floor: Bedroom (1King) w/ En Suite Full Bathroom
***TOTAL OF 8 BEDS - 2 Kings & 2 Queens & 2 Bunks***

The space
Welcome to the Luxurious Nashville Showstopper in West End!

This upscale townhouse, one of six in a prime location, is designed for style and comfort. Just steps from Centennial Park and The Parthenon, and a quick 4-minute Uber ride to Midtown’s bars, Broadway, and downtown hotspots, this rental offers unmatched access to Nashville’s best attractions.

The 2nd-floor bonus room features a sleek garage door, creating a seamless transition to indoor/outdoor living space for relaxed gatherings.

Every bedroom includes top-quality pillow-top mattresses, luxury linens, and a 55” 4K Samsung TV, while the main living area has a 65” TV with BOSE soundbar for movie nights.

LOCATION:
*2 miles to the Honky Tonks on lower Broadway 
*1.5 miles to Belmont University
*0.8 miles to Vanderbilt University
*2.5 miles to Bridgestone Arena 
*3 miles to the Titan's Stadium
*Only a 4 minute Uber ride to all of the Midtown bars and restaurants
*One block away from beautiful Centennial Park and one of Nashville's most stunning landmarks "The Parthenon"...Doesn't get any better! 
*You're right by the interstate so you can get anywhere quickly! :)

✅ NO CHECK OUT TO-DO'S!! ✅
We are thrilled to have our guests stay with us on their vacation! We want our guests to spend their vacation relaxing and not worry about tasks to do early in the morning prior to driving home or hurrying to the airport! All we ask is that you lock the doors on the way out and our crew takes care of everything! :)

🏠 Spacious & Perfect for Groups! 🏠
Looking for extra room? This charming townhome is part of a row of six, making it ideal for large groups to stay together in comfort. Whether it’s a work retreat, family reunion, or wedding celebration, everyone can have a blast in the same location! 
If this particular unit is unavailable or if you need up to six adjoining townhomes for your group, don’t hesitate to reach out. We’d love to help accommodate your needs – just send us a message to explore our other listings!
